title: SORREL SOUP
instructions: Take a handful of sorrel, cook it ten minutes in a spoonful of fresh butter, add a quart of water,  salt and pepper, and let it simmer half an hour over a slow fire. Stir in white of an egg, and then let it cook two minutes only, stirring it all the time. Rub in a cup the yolk of an egg with a small piece of butter. Add a cup of cream. Put some pieces of stale bread cut in slices in the bottom of your soup tureen. Chop fine some chervil and sprinkle on top just as you serve it very hot. -LENONIE PENIN.
